additions.actor: Authorized backoffice operator or trusted ViStay service

additions.context: SettlementPeriod currently checks only opener versus approver, stores rejection/reopen text in notes, clears approval on reopen, and allows an approved period to be reopened in place. Replace those behaviors additively.
inScope: Freeze calculation version/fingerprint, source cutoff, term snapshot, approved adjustments and totals on submit; reject any changed dependency before approval.
Require checker distinct from opener, calculator and adjustment proposers; record submitter/reviewer decisions, reason, revision, timestamps and authorization evidence in append-only transition rows.
Model submit, approve/reject, close after payable creation/finality and corrective reopen; a closed/approved historical version remains immutable and reopen creates a linked correction revision.

Corrective reopen creates CORRECTION_PENDING -> CALCULATED successor linked to the frozen predecessor and requires reason plus distinct approval.
